events.title: Demo Hotfix - Input Fix
events.summary: Fixed an issue that could cause input errors when switching between keyboard and controller, particularly after changing scenes.Thanks to everyone playing the demo!

events.title: Demo Update: New Defend Mission & Field Turrets!

events.title: Demo Submitted for Review
events.summary: The Star Seed Protocol demo has been submitted to Steam for review. Once it is approved, I’ll make it available as soon as possible. The demo includes the core gameplay loop: fighting alien swarms, experimenting with different weapons, deploying turrets and drones, using implants and abilities, and progressing through the research system.
